hard_rejects.definition: face or identity differs from Subject00
visible hairline or hair appearance changes or is invented
skin tone changes beyond source-lighting variation
height, build, or body proportions change
frozen pose or limb configuration changes
camera, framing, orientation, or perspective changes
face is covered by garment or artifact
one or more hands or feet disappear or are cropped
extra, duplicated, fused, or malformed body parts
wrong category, color, cut, sleeve length, or upper/lower structure
garment merges into body without a coherent boundary
source background or lighting is materially altered
extra person or unrequested object appears
new text, numbering, logo, watermark, border, or collage appears
edge/mask defects make the asset unusable

quality_grades.A: no visible artifact at inspection scale
quality_grades.B: minor non-scientific artifact outside identity and garment boundaries

quality_retry_policy: scientific quality rejection is retained and is not an automatic retry reason
